# Anbennar Overhaul: generated by tools/build_holds.py from tools/data/holds.py; do not edit by hand.

# A hold-less dwarf who settles a lost hold can bring its culture back, while its kingdom is unformed.

aov_revive_verkal_gulan_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
	}
	decision_group_type = major
	sort_order = 96
	ai_check_interval = 60

	desc = aov_revive_verkal_gulan_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = aov_revive_verkal_gulan_decision_tooltip
	confirm_text = aov_revive_verkal_gulan_decision_confirm

	is_shown = {
		is_landed = yes
		is_dwarvish_culture = yes
		has_title = title:b_gulandhum
		any_held_title = {
			count = 1
			tier = tier_barony
			title_province = { aov_is_hold = yes }
		}
		NOT = { exists = title:k_verkal_gulan.holder }
		NOT = { has_culture = culture:gold_dwarvish }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_available_adult = yes
	}

	cost = {
		prestige = aov_revival_prestige
	}

	effect = {
		set_culture = culture:gold_dwarvish
		every_spouse = {
			set_culture = culture:gold_dwarvish
		}
		every_child = {
			set_culture = culture:gold_dwarvish
		}
		title:c_verkal_gulan = { set_county_culture = culture:gold_dwarvish }
	}

	ai_potential = {
		capital_province = title:b_gulandhum.title_province
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

	is_shown = {
		is_landed = yes
		is_dwarvish_culture = yes
		has_title = title:b_er_natvir
		any_held_title = {
			count = 1
			tier = tier_barony
			title_province = { aov_is_hold = yes }
		}
		NOT = { exists = title:k_er_natvir.holder }
		NOT = { has_culture = culture:dagrite_dwarvish }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_available_adult = yes
	}

	cost = {
		prestige = aov_revival_prestige
	}

	effect = {
		set_culture = culture:dagrite_dwarvish
		every_spouse = {
			set_culture = culture:dagrite_dwarvish
		}
		every_child = {
			set_culture = culture:dagrite_dwarvish
		}
		title:c_er_natvir = { set_county_culture = culture:dagrite_dwarvish }
	}

	ai_potential = {
		capital_province = title:b_er_natvir.title_province
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}
